hints.title: Consecutive Negatives Tracking
hints.text: Maintain a list of previously seen positive integers and track consecutive occurrences of -1.

hints.title: Positive Integer Action
hints.text: When a positive integer is encountered, append it to the seen list and reset consecutive -1 count to 0.

hints.title: Negative One Action
hints.text: When -1 is encountered, increment count k. If k does not exceed the count of seen numbers, output the k-th most recent seen number, otherwise -1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass simulating stack of visited integers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation is already linear and optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list of seen integers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Track visited positive integers and reverse offset lookup.
